# uzc_remote_access_vpn (Resource)

Enables Remote Access VPN on a UzCloud IP address (POST /ipaddresses/{ip}/remote-access-vpns, which the spec documents as taking no parameters). The resource ID is "{ip_address}/{vpn_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_remote_access_vpn" "example" {
  ip_address = uzc_ip_address.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) Slug of the uzc_ip_address to enable Remote Access VPN on. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{ip_address}/{vpn_id}". Used for import.
- `vpn_id` (String) Server-assigned VPN id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_remote_access_vpn.example <ip-address-slug>/<vpn-id>
```
